```{r}
if (length(tcga_quant_files) == 0) {
  stop("No STAR gene count TSV files found.")
}

# Helper: extract sample barcode from filename/folder later if present in metadata
# For now we use folder order and recover from tcga survival later by overlap if needed.
# Build expression matrix from TPM column.

read_one_tcga_tpm <- function(f) {
  dat <- fread(f, data.table = FALSE)
  
  # remove technical summary rows
  dat <- dat[grepl("^ENSG", dat$gene_id), ]
  
  # keep the 3 columns we need
  dat <- dat[, c("gene_id", "gene_name", "tpm_unstranded")]
  colnames(dat) <- c("gene_id", "gene_name", "tpm")
  
  dat
}

# Read first file to initialize
first_dat <- read_one_tcga_tpm(tcga_quant_files[1])

cat("First filtered file dim:", dim(first_dat), "\n")
print(head(first_dat))

gene_annot <- first_dat[, c("gene_id", "gene_name")]

# Build matrix
expr_list <- lapply(tcga_quant_files, function(f) {
  dat <- read_one_tcga_tpm(f)
  dat$tpm
})

expr_mat <- do.call(cbind, expr_list)

# Use file basenames temporarily as sample names
colnames(expr_mat) <- basename(dirname(tcga_quant_files))
rownames(expr_mat) <- first_dat$gene_id

cat("Raw TCGA TPM matrix dim:", dim(expr_mat), "\n")

# Save raw Ensembl-level matrix
saveRDS(expr_mat, file.path(root_dir, "results", "tcga_tpm_ensembl_raw.rds"))
write.csv(gene_annot, file.path(root_dir, "results", "tcga_gene_annotation.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("Raw TCGA TPM matrix saved\n")
```

```{r}
# Load the matrix we just saved
expr_mat <- readRDS(file.path(root_dir, "results", "tcga_tpm_ensembl_raw.rds"))

############################
# 1. Check duplicates (Ensembl IDs with versions)

# 2. Check zero variance genes
############################

############################
# 3. Check missing values
############################

cat("Total NA values:", na_count, "\n")

############################
# 4. Check non-finite values
############################

inf_count <- sum(!is.finite(expr_mat))
cat("Non-finite values (Inf/-Inf/NA):", inf_count, "\n")

############################
# 5. Quick summary of TPM
############################

summary(as.vector(expr_mat))
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Load raw matrix + annotation
expr_mat <- readRDS(file.path(root_dir, "results", "tcga_tpm_ensembl_raw.rds"))
gene_annot <- read.csv(file.path(root_dir, "results", "tcga_gene_annotation.csv"))

############################
# FAST: Clean Ensembl IDs once
############################

rownames_clean <- sub("\\..*$", "", rownames(expr_mat))

############################
# FAST: Prepare annotation lookup
############################

gene_annot$gene_id_clean <- sub("\\..*$", "", gene_annot$gene_id)
# Create named vector for faster lookup
symbol_lookup <- setNames(gene_annot$gene_name, gene_annot$gene_id_clean)
# Keep only unique, non-empty symbols
symbol_lookup <- symbol_lookup[!is.na(symbol_lookup) & symbol_lookup != ""]

############################
# FAST: Match and filter in one step
############################

# Find which rows have valid symbols
valid_idx <- which(rownames_clean %in% names(symbol_lookup))
expr_mat_filtered <- expr_mat[valid_idx, ]
matched_symbols <- symbol_lookup[rownames_clean[valid_idx]]

cat("After matching symbols:", nrow(expr_mat_filtered), "genes\n")

############################
# FAST: Collapse duplicates using rowsum (much faster than group_by)
############################

# Create matrix with symbols as row names
rownames(expr_mat_filtered) <- matched_symbols

# Use rowsum for fast aggregation
expr_collapsed <- rowsum(expr_mat_filtered, group = matched_symbols, reorder = TRUE)

cat("After collapsing duplicates:", nrow(expr_collapsed), "genes\n")

############################
# FAST: Remove zero variance (vectorized)
############################

# Calculate variance efficiently
vars <- apply(expr_collapsed, 1, var)
expr_collapsed <- expr_collapsed[vars > 0, ]

cat("After removing zero variance:", nrow(expr_collapsed), "genes\n")

############################
# FAST: Log2 transform
############################

crc_tpm_log_gene <- log2(expr_collapsed + 1)

############################
# Save
############################

saveRDS(crc_tpm_log_gene, file.path(root_dir, "results", "crc_tpm_log_gene.rds"))

cat("FINAL MATRIX READY:", dim(crc_tpm_log_gene), "\n")
```

```{r}
library(TCGAbiolinks)

# UUIDs currently used as expression column names
expr_uuid <- colnames(crc_tpm_log_gene)

cat("Expression UUID count:", length(expr_uuid), "\n")

# Query GDC metadata for the same TCGA-COAD RNA-seq files
query_map <- GDCquery(
  project = "TCGA-COAD",
  data.category = "Transcriptome Profiling",
  data.type = "Gene Expression Quantification",
  workflow.type = "STAR - Counts"
)

meta_map <- getResults(query_map)

cat("GDC metadata dim:", dim(meta_map), "\n")
print(colnames(meta_map))

# Keep only columns useful for mapping
map_cols <- intersect(
  c("file_id", "file_name", "cases", "sample.submitter_id", "cases.submitter_id"),
  colnames(meta_map)
)

uuid_map <- meta_map[, map_cols, drop = FALSE]

cat("Mapping table dim:", dim(uuid_map), "\n")
print(head(uuid_map, 10))

# Match file UUIDs to your expression UUIDs
m <- match(expr_uuid, uuid_map$file_id)

matched_sample_barcodes <- if ("sample.submitter_id" %in% colnames(uuid_map)) {
  uuid_map$sample.submitter_id[m]
} else {
  rep(NA_character_, length(expr_uuid))
}

cat("Matched sample barcodes:", sum(!is.na(matched_sample_barcodes)), "\n")
print(head(matched_sample_barcodes, 20))

# Rename expression columns where mapping exists
colnames(crc_tpm_log_gene) <- matched_sample_barcodes

# Keep only mapped columns
keep_cols <- !is.na(colnames(crc_tpm_log_gene)) & colnames(crc_tpm_log_gene) != ""
crc_tpm_log_gene <- crc_tpm_log_gene[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]

cat("Expression matrix after barcode mapping:", dim(crc_tpm_log_gene), "\n")
print(head(colnames(crc_tpm_log_gene), 20))

# Save mapped matrix
saveRDS(crc_tpm_log_gene, file.path(root_dir, "results", "crc_tpm_log_gene_mapped.rds"))
```

```{r}
# Load mapped expression
crc_tpm_log_gene <- readRDS(file.path(root_dir, "results", "crc_tpm_log_gene_mapped.rds"))

# Load survival
surv_df2 <- readRDS(tcga_survival_rds_file)
surv_df2 <- as.data.frame(surv_df2)

# Clean survival fields
surv_df2$sample <- as.character(surv_df2$sample)
surv_df2$time <- as.numeric(surv_df2$time)
surv_df2$status <- as.numeric(surv_df2$status)

surv_df2 <- surv_df2[!is.na(surv_df2$sample) & !is.na(surv_df2$time) & !is.na(surv_df2$status), ]
surv_df2 <- surv_df2[surv_df2$time > 0, ]
surv_df2 <- surv_df2[!duplicated(surv_df2$sample), ]

# Create 15-character sample IDs for matching
surv_df2$sample15 <- substr(surv_df2$sample, 1, 15)
expr_sample15 <- substr(colnames(crc_tpm_log_gene), 1, 15)

cat("Survival samples:", nrow(surv_df2), "\n")
cat("Expression samples:", ncol(crc_tpm_log_gene), "\n")

common15 <- intersect(surv_df2$sample15, expr_sample15)
cat("Matched 15-char sample IDs:", length(common15), "\n")

# Keep matched survival rows
surv_df2_match <- surv_df2[surv_df2$sample15 %in% common15, ]

# If duplicates at 15-char level exist in survival, keep first
surv_df2_match <- surv_df2_match[!duplicated(surv_df2_match$sample15), ]

# Keep matched expression columns
expr_keep <- expr_sample15 %in% surv_df2_match$sample15
expr_matched <- crc_tpm_log_gene[, expr_keep, drop = FALSE]
expr_sample15_matched <- substr(colnames(expr_matched), 1, 15)

# Reorder expression columns to survival order
ord <- match(surv_df2_match$sample15, expr_sample15_matched)
expr_matched <- expr_matched[, ord, drop = FALSE]

# Final check
cat("Final matched survival rows:", nrow(surv_df2_match), "\n")
cat("Final matched expression columns:", ncol(expr_matched), "\n")

cat("Do names match now? ", all(surv_df2_match$sample15 == substr(colnames(expr_matched), 1, 15)), "\n")

# Save aligned objects
saveRDS(surv_df2_match, file.path(root_dir, "results", "surv_df2_matched.rds"))
saveRDS(expr_matched, file.path(root_dir, "results", "crc_tpm_log_gene_matched.rds"))
```

```{r}
# Load aligned objects
surv_df2_match <- readRDS(file.path(root_dir, "results", "surv_df2_matched.rds"))
expr_matched <- readRDS(file.path(root_dir, "results", "crc_tpm_log_gene_matched.rds"))

# Load DE table
de_sym <- read.csv(de_symbols_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Strict DE genes
sig_strict_genes <- unique(
  na.omit(de_sym$symbol[de_sym$adj.P.Val < 0.01 & abs(de_sym$logFC) > 1.5])
)

cat("Strict genes (symbols):", length(sig_strict_genes), "\n")

# Keep genes present in matched expression matrix
genes_for_cox <- intersect(sig_strict_genes, rownames(expr_matched))
cat("Strict genes present in matched expression:", length(genes_for_cox), "\n")

# Build Cox matrix: samples x genes
X_all2 <- t(expr_matched[genes_for_cox, , drop = FALSE])
X_all2 <- as.matrix(X_all2)

cat("Initial Cox matrix dim:", dim(X_all2), "\n")

# Remove zero-variance genes again just in case
sdv <- apply(X_all2, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
X_all2 <- X_all2[, sdv > 0, drop = FALSE]

cat("Cox matrix after zero-variance removal:", dim(X_all2), "\n")

# Build survival object
y <- Surv(surv_df2_match$time, surv_df2_match$status)

# Save
saveRDS(X_all2, file.path(root_dir, "results", "X_all2_matched.rds"))
saveRDS(y, file.path(root_dir, "results", "Surv_y_matched.rds"))

cat("Cox input ready\n")
```

```{r}
# Load data
X_all2 <- readRDS(file.path(root_dir, "results", "X_all2_matched.rds"))
y <- readRDS(file.path(root_dir, "results", "Surv_y_matched.rds"))

cat("Running univariate Cox on", ncol(X_all2), "genes...\n")

# Run Cox for each gene
cox_p <- apply(X_all2, 2, function(x) {
  fit <- tryCatch(coxph(y ~ x), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)
  summary(fit)$coef[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
})

# Create result table
cox_res <- data.frame(
```

```{r}
# Load inputs
X_all2 <- readRDS(file.path(root_dir, "results", "X_all2_matched.rds"))
y <- readRDS(file.path(root_dir, "results", "Surv_y_matched.rds"))
cox_res <- readRDS(file.path(root_dir, "results", "cox_res.rds"))

############################
# 1. Select top genes
############################

topN <- min(300, nrow(cox_res))
lasso_genes <- head(cox_res$gene, topN)

X_lasso <- X_all2[, lasso_genes, drop = FALSE]

cat("Genes entering LASSO:", ncol(X_lasso), "\n")

############################
# 2. Fit LASSO Cox
############################

set.seed(1)

cvfit <- cv.glmnet(
  x = X_lasso,
  y = y,
  family = "cox",
  alpha = 1,
  nfolds = 10
)

# Save model
saveRDS(cvfit, file.path(root_dir, "results", "cvfit_final.rds"))

############################
# 3. Check number of genes per lambda
############################

beta <- as.matrix(coef(cvfit$glmnet.fit))
n_genes <- colSums(beta != 0)

cat("Gene counts across lambdas:\n")
print(table(n_genes))

############################
# 4. Select ~13-gene signature
############################

target <- 13
idx <- which.min(abs(n_genes - target))

cat("Closest to", target, "genes:", n_genes[idx], "\n")

lambda_custom <- cvfit$glmnet.fit$lambda[idx]

coef_custom <- coef(cvfit$glmnet.fit, s = lambda_custom)

nz <- which(as.numeric(coef_custom) != 0)

signature_custom <- data.frame(
  gene = rownames(coef_custom)[nz],
  coef = as.numeric(coef_custom)[nz],
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

signature_custom <- signature_custom[order(-abs(signature_custom$coef)), ]

############################
# 5. Save signature
############################

write.csv(signature_custom,
          file.path(root_dir, "results", "final_13_gene_signature.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

saveRDS(signature_custom,
        file.path(root_dir, "results", "signature_final.rds"))

cat("Final signature size:", nrow(signature_custom), "\n")
print(signature_custom)

cat("✅ LASSO complete\n")
```

```{r}
# Load objects
signature_custom <- readRDS(file.path(root_dir, "results", "signature_final.rds"))
expr_matched <- readRDS(file.path(root_dir, "results", "crc_tpm_log_gene_matched.rds"))
surv_df2_match <- readRDS(file.path(root_dir, "results", "surv_df2_matched.rds"))

############################
# 1. Extract signature genes
############################

sig_genes <- intersect(signature_custom$gene, rownames(expr_matched))

cat("Signature genes found in expression:", length(sig_genes), "\n")

# Build expression matrix for signature
X_sig <- t(expr_matched[sig_genes, , drop = FALSE])
X_sig <- as.matrix(X_sig)

############################
# 2. Align coefficients
############################

coef_df <- signature_custom[match(colnames(X_sig), signature_custom$gene), ]
beta_sig <- coef_df$coef

############################
# 3. Compute risk score
############################

risk_score <- as.numeric(X_sig %*% beta_sig)

############################
# 4. Add to survival data
############################

surv_sig <- surv_df2_match
surv_sig$risk_score <- risk_score

# Split into high/low groups
median_cut <- median(surv_sig$risk_score, na.rm = TRUE)

surv_sig$risk_group <- ifelse(
  surv_sig$risk_score >= median_cut,
  "High", "Low"
)

cat("Risk group distribution:\n")
print(table(surv_sig$risk_group))

############################
# 5. Kaplan-Meier plot
############################

fit_km <- survfit(Surv(time, status) ~ risk_group, data = surv_sig)

library(survminer)

p <- ggsurvplot(
  fit_km,
  data = surv_sig,
  pval = TRUE,
  risk.table = TRUE,
  conf.int = FALSE,
  title = "TCGA CRC Survival by Risk Group",
  palette = c("#E74C3C", "#2ECC71")
)

print(p)

############################
# 6. Save results
############################

write.csv(surv_sig,
```

```{r}
# Load objects
signature_custom <- readRDS(file.path(root_dir, "results", "signature_final.rds"))
geo_eset <- readRDS(geo_eset_file)
gse_data <- readRDS(gse_validation_rds_file)

############################
# 1. Extract expression matrix
############################

expr_geo <- exprs(geo_eset)
cat("GSE expression dim:", dim(expr_geo), "\n")

############################
# 2. Check gene symbols
############################

# Try to get gene symbols from feature data
fdata <- fData(geo_eset)

cat("Feature data columns:\n")
print(colnames(fdata))

# Common columns: "Gene Symbol", "GENE_SYMBOL", "Symbol"
symbol_col <- colnames(fdata)[grepl("symbol", colnames(fdata), ignore.case = TRUE)][1]

if (is.na(symbol_col)) {
  stop("No gene symbol column found in GEO data.")
}

cat("Using symbol column:", symbol_col, "\n")

gene_symbols <- fdata[[symbol_col]]

############################
# 3. Map expression to symbols
############################

expr_geo_df <- as.data.frame(expr_geo)
expr_geo_df$symbol <- gene_symbols

# Remove missing symbols
expr_geo_df <- expr_geo_df[!is.na(expr_geo_df$symbol) & expr_geo_df$symbol != "", ]

# Collapse duplicates
library(dplyr)

expr_geo_collapsed <- expr_geo_df %>%
  group_by(symbol) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), mean), .groups = "drop")

# Convert to matrix
expr_geo_mat <- as.data.frame(expr_geo_collapsed)
rownames(expr_geo_mat) <- expr_geo_mat$symbol
expr_geo_mat$symbol <- NULL

expr_geo_mat <- as.matrix(expr_geo_mat)

cat("After collapsing GEO matrix:", dim(expr_geo_mat), "\n")

############################
# 4. Log transform if needed
############################

# GEO is usually already log2 — check range
summary_vals <- summary(as.vector(expr_geo_mat))
print(summary_vals)

if (max(expr_geo_mat, na.rm = TRUE) > 50) {
  expr_geo_mat <- log2(expr_geo_mat + 1)
  cat("Applied log2 transform to GEO\n")
}

############################
# 5. Build risk score
############################

sig_genes <- intersect(signature_custom$gene, rownames(expr_geo_mat))

cat("Signature genes found in GEO:", length(sig_genes), "\n")

X_geo <- t(expr_geo_mat[sig_genes, , drop = FALSE])

coef_df <- signature_custom[match(colnames(X_geo), signature_custom$gene), ]
beta_geo <- coef_df$coef

risk_geo <- as.numeric(X_geo %*% beta_geo)

############################
# 6. Prepare survival data
############################

gse_df <- as.data.frame(gse_data)

# Use OS columns already created earlier
gse_df$time <- as.numeric(gse_df$os_time_months) * 30   # months → days
gse_df$status <- as.numeric(gse_df$os_event)

# Match samples
common_samples <- intersect(rownames(X_geo), gse_df$sample)

cat("Matched GEO samples:", length(common_samples), "\n")

gse_df_match <- gse_df[gse_df$sample %in% common_samples, ]

# Reorder expression
X_geo <- X_geo[match(gse_df_match$sample, rownames(X_geo)), ]

# Add risk score
gse_df_match$risk_score <- as.numeric(X_geo %*% beta_geo)

# Split groups
median_cut <- median(gse_df_match$risk_score, na.rm = TRUE)

gse_df_match$risk_group <- ifelse(
  gse_df_match$risk_score >= median_cut,
  "High", "Low"
)

cat("Risk group distribution (GEO):\n")
print(table(gse_df_match$risk_group))

############################
# 7. Kaplan-Meier validation
############################

fit_geo <- survfit(Surv(time, status) ~ risk_group, data = gse_df_match)

p_geo <- ggsurvplot(
  fit_geo,
  data = gse_df_match,
  pval = TRUE,
  risk.table = TRUE,
  title = "GSE39582 Validation",
  palette = c("#E74C3C", "#2ECC71")
)

print(p_geo)

############################
# 8. Save
############################

write.csv(gse_df_match,
          file.path(root_dir, "results", "gse_validation_results.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

cat("✅ GEO validation complete\n")
```

```{r}
# Load data
common_genes <- readRDS(file.path(root_dir, "results", "common_genes_tcga_geo.rds"))
tcga_expr <- readRDS(file.path(root_dir, "results", "crc_tpm_log_gene_matched.rds"))
surv_df2_match <- readRDS(file.path(root_dir, "results", "surv_df2_matched.rds"))
de_sym <- read.csv(de_symbols_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

############################
# 1. Restrict to common genes
############################

tcga_expr_common <- tcga_expr[intersect(rownames(tcga_expr), common_genes), ]

cat("TCGA matrix after common gene filter:", dim(tcga_expr_common), "\n")

############################
# 2. Apply DE filter again
############################

sig_genes <- unique(
  na.omit(de_sym$symbol[de_sym$adj.P.Val < 0.01 & abs(de_sym$logFC) > 1.5])
)

genes_for_cox <- intersect(sig_genes, rownames(tcga_expr_common))

cat("Strict genes after common filter:", length(genes_for_cox), "\n")

############################
# 3. Build Cox matrix
############################

X <- t(tcga_expr_common[genes_for_cox, , drop = FALSE])
X <- as.matrix(X)

y <- Surv(surv_df2_match$time, surv_df2_match$status)

cat("Cox matrix dim:", dim(X), "\n")

############################
# 4. Univariate Cox
############################

cox_p <- apply(X, 2, function(x) {
  fit <- tryCatch(coxph(y ~ x), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)
  summary(fit)$coef[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
})

cox_res <- data.frame(
  gene = names(cox_p),
  p = as.numeric(cox_p),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cox_res <- cox_res[!is.na(cox_res$p), ]
cox_res <- cox_res[order(cox_res$p), ]

cat("Top genes after refit:\n")
print(head(cox_res, 10))

############################
# 5. LASSO (top 300)
############################

topN <- min(300, nrow(cox_res))
lasso_genes <- head(cox_res$gene, topN)

X_lasso <- X[, lasso_genes, drop = FALSE]

set.seed(1)
cvfit <- cv.glmnet(
  x = X_lasso,
  y = y,
  family = "cox",
  alpha = 1,
  nfolds = 10
)

############################
# 6. Select ~10–15 genes
############################

beta <- as.matrix(coef(cvfit$glmnet.fit))
n_genes <- colSums(beta != 0)

target <- 10   # slightly smaller improves generalization
idx <- which.min(abs(n_genes - target))

cat("Selected gene count:", n_genes[idx], "\n")

coef_custom <- coef(cvfit$glmnet.fit, s = cvfit$glmnet.fit$lambda[idx])

nz <- which(as.numeric(coef_custom) != 0)

signature_new <- data.frame(
  gene = rownames(coef_custom)[nz],
  coef = as.numeric(coef_custom)[nz],
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

signature_new <- signature_new[order(-abs(signature_new$coef)), ]

############################
# 7. Save
############################

write.csv(signature_new,
          file.path(root_dir, "results", "signature_refit_common.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

saveRDS(signature_new,
        file.path(root_dir, "results", "signature_refit_common.rds"))

cat("Final refit signature size:", nrow(signature_new), "\n")
print(signature_new)
```

```{r}
# 1. Expression matrix
############################

expr_geo <- exprs(geo_eset)
fdata <- fData(geo_eset)

cat("Raw GEO matrix:", dim(expr_geo), "\n")

############################
# 2. Extract gene symbols
############################

symbol_col <- colnames(fdata)[grepl("symbol", colnames(fdata), ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
gene_symbols <- fdata[[symbol_col]]

cat("Using symbol column:", symbol_col, "\n")

############################
# 3. Build symbol matrix
############################

expr_geo_df <- as.data.frame(expr_geo)
expr_geo_df$symbol <- gene_symbols

expr_geo_df <- expr_geo_df[!is.na(expr_geo_df$symbol) & expr_geo_df$symbol != "", ]

library(dplyr)

expr_geo_collapsed <- expr_geo_df %>%
  group_by(symbol) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), mean), .groups = "drop")

expr_geo_mat <- as.data.frame(expr_geo_collapsed)
rownames(expr_geo_mat) <- expr_geo_mat$symbol
expr_geo_mat$symbol <- NULL
expr_geo_mat <- as.matrix(expr_geo_mat)

cat("Collapsed GEO matrix:", dim(expr_geo_mat), "\n")

############################
# 4. Prepare survival
############################

gse_df <- as.data.frame(gse_data)

gse_df$sample <- as.character(gse_df$sample)
gse_df$time <- as.numeric(gse_df$os_time_months) * 30
gse_df$status <- as.numeric(gse_df$os_event)

# Clean
gse_df <- gse_df[!is.na(gse_df$sample) & !is.na(gse_df$time) & !is.na(gse_df$status), ]
gse_df <- gse_df[gse_df$time > 0, ]
gse_df <- gse_df[!duplicated(gse_df$sample), ]

cat("GEO survival samples:", nrow(gse_df), "\n")

############################
# 5. Match samples
############################

common_samples <- intersect(colnames(expr_geo_mat), gse_df$sample)

cat("Matched GEO samples:", length(common_samples), "\n")

expr_geo_mat <- expr_geo_mat[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]
gse_df <- gse_df[gse_df$sample %in% common_samples, ]

# Reorder
expr_geo_mat <- expr_geo_mat[, match(gse_df$sample, colnames(expr_geo_mat))]

############################
# 6. Final objects
############################

X_geo_all <- t(expr_geo_mat)
X_geo_all <- as.matrix(X_geo_all)

y_geo <- Surv(gse_df$time, gse_df$status)

cat("Final GEO Cox matrix:", dim(X_geo_all), "\n")

# Save
saveRDS(X_geo_all, file.path(root_dir, "results", "X_geo_all.rds"))
saveRDS(y_geo, file.path(root_dir, "results", "y_geo.rds"))

cat("✅ GEO training data ready\n")
```
```{r}
# Load GEO Cox data
X_geo_all <- readRDS(file.path(root_dir, "results", "X_geo_all.rds"))
y_geo <- readRDS(file.path(root_dir, "results", "y_geo.rds"))

cat("Running GEO univariate Cox on", ncol(X_geo_all), "genes...\n")

############################
# Univariate Cox
############################

cox_p <- apply(X_geo_all, 2, function(x) {
  fit <- tryCatch(coxph(y_geo ~ x), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)
  summary(fit)$coef[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
})

cox_res_geo <- data.frame(
  gene = colnames(X_geo_all),
  p = as.numeric(cox_p),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cox_res_geo <- cox_res_geo[!is.na(cox_res_geo$p), ]
cox_res_geo <- cox_res_geo[order(cox_res_geo$p), ]

############################
# Save
############################

write.csv(cox_res_geo,
          file.path(root_dir, "results", "cox_geo_ranked.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

saveRDS(cox_res_geo,
        file.path(root_dir, "results", "cox_geo_ranked.rds"))

############################
# Show top genes
############################

cat("Top 15 GEO prognostic genes:\n")
print(head(cox_res_geo, 15))

cat("✅ GEO Cox complete\n")
```

```{r}
# Load GEO Cox results
cox_res_geo <- readRDS(file.path(root_dir, "results", "cox_geo_ranked.rds"))
X_geo_all <- readRDS(file.path(root_dir, "results", "X_geo_all.rds"))
y_geo <- readRDS(file.path(root_dir, "results", "y_geo.rds"))

############################
# 1. Select top genes
############################

topN <- 200   # smaller = more robust
lasso_genes <- head(cox_res_geo$gene, topN)

X_lasso <- X_geo_all[, lasso_genes, drop = FALSE]

cat("Genes entering GEO LASSO:", ncol(X_lasso), "\n")

############################
# 2. Fit LASSO Cox
############################

set.seed(1)

cvfit_geo <- cv.glmnet(
  x = X_lasso,
  y = y_geo,
  family = "cox",
  alpha = 1,
  nfolds = 10
)

############################
# 3. Check gene counts
############################

beta <- as.matrix(coef(cvfit_geo$glmnet.fit))
n_genes <- colSums(beta != 0)

cat("Gene counts across lambdas:\n")
print(table(n_genes))

############################
# 4. Select small signature
############################

target <- 6
idx <- which.min(abs(n_genes - target))

cat("Selected gene count:", n_genes[idx], "\n")

coef_geo <- coef(cvfit_geo$glmnet.fit, s = cvfit_geo$glmnet.fit$lambda[idx])

nz <- which(as.numeric(coef_geo) != 0)

signature_geo <- data.frame(
  gene = rownames(coef_geo)[nz],
  coef = as.numeric(coef_geo)[nz],
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

signature_geo <- signature_geo[order(-abs(signature_geo$coef)), ]

############################
# 5. Save
############################

write.csv(signature_geo,
          file.path(root_dir, "results", "signature_geo_trained.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

saveRDS(signature_geo,
        file.path(root_dir, "results", "signature_geo_trained.rds"))

cat("Final GEO-trained signature size:", nrow(signature_geo), "\n")
print(signature_geo)

cat("✅ GEO LASSO complete\n")
```

```{r}
# 2. Build risk score

X_tcga <- t(expr_tcga[sig_genes, , drop = FALSE])

coef_df <- signature_geo[match(colnames(X_tcga), signature_geo$gene), ]
beta_tcga <- coef_df$coef

risk_tcga <- as.numeric(X_tcga %*% beta_tcga)

############################
# 3. Add to survival
############################

surv_tcga$risk_score <- risk_tcga

median_cut <- median(surv_tcga$risk_score, na.rm = TRUE)

surv_tcga$risk_group <- ifelse(
  surv_tcga$risk_score >= median_cut,
  "High", "Low"
)

cat("TCGA risk group distribution:\n")
print(table(surv_tcga$risk_group))

############################
# 4. Kaplan-Meier
############################

fit_tcga <- survfit(Surv(time, status) ~ risk_group, data = surv_tcga)

p_tcga <- ggsurvplot(
  fit_tcga,
  data = surv_tcga,
  pval = TRUE,
  risk.table = TRUE,
  title = "TCGA Validation (GEO-trained 5-Gene Signature)",
  palette = c("#E74C3C", "#2ECC71")
)

print(p_tcga)

############################
# 5. Save

write.csv(surv_tcga,
          file.path(root_dir, "results", "tcga_validation_geo_model.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

cat("✅ TCGA validation complete\n")
```

```{r}
    paste0("1-year AUC = ", round(roc_res$AUC[1], 3)),

  col = c("red", "blue", "green"),
  lwd = 2
)
```

```{r}
library(survival)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Optional packages
has_survminer <- requireNamespace("survminer", quietly = TRUE)
has_forestmodel <- requireNamespace("forestmodel", quietly = TRUE)

# Load TCGA data with collapsed stage
tcga_val2 <- readRDS(file.path(root_dir, "results", "tcga_validation_with_stage.rds"))

# Recreate collapsed stage if not already saved
if (!"stage_simple" %in% colnames(tcga_val2)) {
  stage_chr <- as.character(tcga_val2$stage)

  tcga_val2$stage_simple <- ifelse(
    stage_chr %in% c("Stage I", "Stage IA"),
    "Stage I",
    ifelse(
      stage_chr %in% c("Stage II", "Stage IIA", "Stage IIB", "Stage IIC"),
      "Stage II",
      ifelse(
        stage_chr %in% c("Stage III", "Stage IIIA", "Stage IIIB", "Stage IIIC"),
        "Stage III",
        ifelse(
          stage_chr %in% c("Stage IV", "Stage IVA", "Stage IVB"),
          "Stage IV",
          NA
        )
      )
    )
  )

  tcga_val2$stage_simple <- factor(
    tcga_val2$stage_simple,
    levels = c("Stage I", "Stage II", "Stage III", "Stage IV")
  )
}

# Keep complete cases for the final model
tcga_val2 <- tcga_val2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(time), !is.na(status), !is.na(risk_score), !is.na(stage_simple))

# Final corrected multivariate model
fit_multi2 <- coxph(Surv(time, status) ~ risk_score + stage_simple, data = tcga_val2)

# Save the corrected model
saveRDS(fit_multi2, file.path(root_dir, "results", "cox_multivariate_model_stage_simple.rds"))

cat("\nCorrected multivariate model summary:\n")
print(summary(fit_multi2))
```

```{r}
if (has_forestmodel) {
  library(forestmodel)

  forest_plot2 <- forest_model(fit_multi2)
  print(forest_plot2)
}
# Extract coefficients
coef_summary <- summary(fit_multi2)$coefficients
confint_summary <- confint(fit_multi2)

forest_data <- data.frame(
  Variable = rownames(coef_summary),
  HR = exp(coef_summary[, "coef"]),
  CI_lower = exp(confint_summary[, 1]),
  CI_upper = exp(confint_summary[, 2]),
  P_value = coef_summary[, "Pr(>|z|)"],
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Clean variable names
forest_data$Variable <- gsub("^risk_score$", "Risk score", forest_data$Variable)
forest_data$Variable <- gsub("^stage_simpleStage II$", "Stage II vs I", forest_data$Variable)
forest_data$Variable <- gsub("^stage_simpleStage III$", "Stage III vs I", forest_data$Variable)
forest_data$Variable <- gsub("^stage_simpleStage IV$", "Stage IV vs I", forest_data$Variable)

# Significance stars
forest_data$Signif <- ifelse(
  forest_data$P_value < 0.001, "***",
  ifelse(
    forest_data$P_value < 0.01, "**",
    ifelse(forest_data$P_value < 0.05, "*", "")
  )
)

# Label text
forest_data$Label <- paste0(
  sprintf("%.2f", forest_data$HR),
  " (",
  sprintf("%.2f", forest_data$CI_lower),
  "–",
  sprintf("%.2f", forest_data$CI_upper),
  ") ",
  forest_data$Signif
)

# Expand x-axis room for labels
xmax <- max(forest_data$CI_upper, na.rm = TRUE) * 2

p <- ggplot(forest_data, aes(x = HR, y = reorder(Variable, HR))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = CI_lower, xmax = CI_upper),
    height = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_x_log10(limits = c(min(forest_data$CI_lower) * 0.8, xmax)) +
  labs(
    title = "Multivariate Cox Regression Analysis",
    subtitle = "TCGA validation cohort",
    x = "Hazard ratio (95% CI)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = CI_upper * 1.15, label = Label),
    hjust = 0,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")

print(p)

ggsave(
  file.path(root_dir, "results", "forest_plot_manual_stage_simple.png"),
  p,
  width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 300
)

ggsave(
  file.path(root_dir, "results", "forest_plot_manual_stage_simple.pdf"),
  p,
  width = 10, height = 5
)

cat("\n✅ Forest plot saved to results/\n")
```

```{r}
library(pheatmap)

sig_genes <- c("PPFIA4", "NKAIN4", "RYR2", "XCL1", "C8G", "LRRN4")

# Genes present
sig_present <- intersect(sig_genes, rownames(expr_mat))

# Convert expression colnames to 15-char IDs
expr_col15 <- substr(colnames(expr_mat), 1, 15)

# Match samples
common_samples15 <- intersect(expr_col15, tcga_val2$sample15)

cat("Matched samples using 15-char IDs:", length(common_samples15), "\n")

# Keep matching expression columns
expr_keep <- expr_col15 %in% common_samples15
expr_sig <- expr_mat[sig_present, expr_keep, drop = FALSE]
expr_sig_col15 <- substr(colnames(expr_sig), 1, 15)

# Reorder columns to tcga_val2 order
tcga_val2_sub <- tcga_val2[tcga_val2$sample15 %in% common_samples15, , drop = FALSE]
tcga_val2_sub <- tcga_val2_sub[match(expr_sig_col15, tcga_val2_sub$sample15), , drop = FALSE]

cat("Heatmap matrix dim before scaling:\n")

# Annotation
annotation_col <- data.frame(Risk = tcga_val2_sub$risk_group)
rownames(annotation_col) <- colnames(expr_sig)

# Scale by gene
expr_sig_scaled <- t(scale(t(expr_sig)))

pheatmap(
  expr_sig_scaled,
  annotation_col = annotation_col,
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  main = "6-Gene Signature Expression Heatmap"
)

# Save
png("results/heatmap_signature.png", width = 900, height = 650)
pheatmap(
  expr_sig_scaled,
  annotation_col = annotation_col,
  show_colnames = FALSE,

)
dev.off()
```
